stories.title: Usa, la Corte Suprema dà il via libera all’esecuzione di Christa Pike, ma lei sopravvive a due iniezioni

en.title: USA, Supreme Court approves execution of Christa Pike, but she survives two injections
en.summary: A 50-year-old woman convicted of a crime committed as a teenager received approval for execution from the US Supreme Court, though she survived two lethal injections. Her lawyers filed an emergency motion to halt the procedure.

stories.title: L'Iran riceve la risposta americana, Trump: "Forse li faccio saltare in aria"

en.title: Iran receives American response, Trump: "Maybe I'll blow them up"
en.summary: The US President stated the war will end soon and gas prices will drop, while oil exceeded 103 dollars per barrel. In Gaza, Israeli forces killed nine people including a journalist.

stories.title: Terrore sul Dubai-Tel Aviv: il co-pilota dirotta l’aereo ma i passeggeri lo bloccano

en.title: Terror on Dubai-Tel Aviv flight: co-pilot hijacks plane but passengers block him
en.summary: An Omani co-pilot stabbed the captain and attempted to crash a Flydubai flight but was stopped by passengers. Two off-duty pilots took control of the aircraft.

stories.title: Vittorio Sgarbi ricoverato al Gemelli di Roma

en.title: Vittorio Sgarbi hospitalized at Gemelli in Rome
en.summary: Italian cultural figure Vittorio Sgarbi was admitted to a Rome hospital in serious condition in intensive care, according to reports.

stories.title: Vittorio Sgarbi ricoverato al Gemelli in terapia intensiva

en.title: Vittorio Sgarbi hospitalized at Gemelli in intensive care
en.summary: Italian art critic and politician Vittorio Sgarbi has been admitted to intensive care at Gemelli Hospital and is reported to be in serious condition.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran, le news di oggi. Trump: “Forse facciamo saltare in aria gli iraniani”. Esplode gasdotto in Siria, tre centrali elettriche fuori uso

en.title: War in Iran, today's news. Trump: "Maybe we blow up the Iranians". Gas pipeline explodes in Syria, three power plants out of service
en.summary: A gas pipeline explosion in Syria has disabled three electrical power plants. Trump commented on potential military response regarding Iran.

stories.title: Vittorio Sgarbi ricoverato in terapia intensiva a Roma

en.title: Vittorio Sgarbi hospitalized in intensive care in Rome
en.summary: Vittorio Sgarbi has been admitted to the intensive care unit at Gemelli Hospital in Rome and is reportedly in serious condition.

stories.title: Trump, 'stiamo studiando risposta all'Iran per il ruolo a Fairford'

en.title: Trump, 'we are studying response to Iran for the role at Fairford'
en.summary: Trump stated that the United States is currently working on developing a response to Iran regarding an incident at Fairford.

stories.title: Il ct del Portogallo: "Nessun caso Ronaldo ma contro la Danimarca non gioca", CR7 lascia la squadra

en.title: Portugal coach: "No Ronaldo case but he won't play against Denmark", CR7 leaves squad
en.summary: Portugal's coach Jorge Jesus stated that Cristiano Ronaldo will not play in the match against Denmark, with defender Ramos starting instead. Ronaldo departed the stadium after the Norway match and indicated he would provide an explanation.

stories.title: Aggressione con coltello in un liceo di Ferrara, arrestato un maggiorenne

en.title: Knife Attack at High School in Ferrara, Adult Arrested
en.summary: An adult attacked a 15-year-old student in a school bathroom in Ferrara. The suspect is under investigation for aggravated assault and illegal possession of a cutting weapon, currently held under house arrest at a medical facility.

stories.title: Piloti fuori servizio e passeggeri, gli eroi del volo FZ1073 Dubai-Tel Aviv

en.title: Off-duty pilots and passengers, heroes of flight FZ1073 Dubai-Tel Aviv
en.summary: Off-duty pilots and passengers stopped an attacker on the flight and ensured everyone reached safety, described as a miracle owing to their actions.

stories.title: Volo Dubai-Tel Aviv: bloccato un pilota armato di coltello. Israele: “Attacco jihadista, evitato un altro 11 settembre”

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight: armed pilot stopped with knife. Israel: "Jihadist attack, another 9/11 averted"
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft reported an emergency while traveling from the United Arab Emirates to Tel Aviv. The plane landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after a pilot armed with a knife was stopped; Israeli officials characterized the incident as a thwarted jihadist attack.

stories.title: In Toscana nuovo polo hi tech di Zcs

en.title: Tuscany welcomes new Zcs high-tech hub
en.summary: Zucchetti Centro Sistemi, a company known for inventing the cordless robotic lawnmower Ambrogio over 25 years ago, is expanding its operations with a new technology center in Tuscany.

stories.title: Bologna, via libera al nuovo stadio da 35mila posti. Investimento da 300 milioni

en.title: Bologna approves new 35,000-capacity stadium. 300 million euro investment
en.summary: Bologna FC and BolognaFiere have agreed to build a multipurpose stadium with 35,000 seats by 2031, with plans for it to host the 2032 European Championships.

stories.title: Lombardia, a Rozzano l’hub del Progetto Rete gestito da Invitalia

en.title: Lombardy, Rozzano hub of Network Project managed by Invitalia
en.summary: Invitalia has inaugurated a hub in Rozzano, Milan, as part of the Network Project aimed at supporting young people aged 16 to 35 in the Lombardy region.

stories.title: I prezzi per gli skipass di Dolomiti Superski

en.title: Dolomiti Superski ski pass prices
en.summary: Dolomiti Superski announced ski pass prices for the 2026/2027 winter season, keeping them largely stable compared to the previous season with a slight increase for daily passes.

stories.title: Aeroporto di Genova, per l’Autorità portuale vale tra 15 e 16 milioni

en.title: Genoa Airport valued between 15 and 16 million euros by Port Authority
en.summary: The Port Authority has assessed the value of Genoa's Cristoforo Colombo Airport, which operates as a joint-stock company, at between 14.9 and 15.9 million euros.
